forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, we have sent it a link. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been saved. You can sign in now.
reset.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Open the link from the message again.

accept.title: Accept invitation
accept.intro: Create your account to join the company.
accept.existingAccount: An account with this email already exists. Sign in, then open the invitation link again.
accept.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Open the link from the message again.

home.title: Dashboard
home.noCompany: No company is linked to your account yet.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: Find a booking by its code to confirm a cash payment or cancel it. The booking list comes later.
bookings.noAccess: Only administrators and booking agents of the company can manage bookings.
bookings.noCompany: No company is linked to your account.
bookings.confirmCashHint: Confirm only after you have received {amount} in cash.
bookings.confirmed: Cash payment confirmed. The tickets are issued.
bookings.cancelWarning: Cancelling releases the seats and cannot be undone.
bookings.cancelled: The booking is cancelled. The seats are free again.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.intro: Seat layouts and buses of your company. A layout comes from the generator; once a trip uses it, it can no longer change.
fleet.noCompany: No company is linked to your account.
fleet.readOnly: You can view the fleet. Only administrators can add or change layouts and buses.

layouts.title: Seat layouts
layouts.archived: “{name}” is archived. Existing buses and trips keep it.

layoutForm.title: New seat layout
layoutForm.name: Name
layoutForm.previewSummary: {seats} seats, {pairs} neighbour pairs for the seating rule
layoutForm.previewInvalid: Enter values within the limits to see the preview.
layoutForm.previewFailed: The preview could not be loaded.

map.label: Seat layout {name}
map.legend: Blue: seat with a neighbour (seating rule applies). Amber: single seat. Grey: back bench.

buses.title: Buses

busForm.title: New bus

routes.title: Routes
routes.intro: Your company's routes: stops in travel order, a cancellation policy and a fare for every segment. Stops and cancellation policy freeze once a trip uses the route.
routes.noCompany: No company is linked to your account yet.
routes.readOnly: You can view routes. Only administrators can create or change them.

list.title: Your routes
list.archived: Route “{name}” archived. Existing trips keep it.

detail.noFares: No current fares. Trips on this route cannot be booked.

form.title: New route
form.fares: Fares in Syrian pounds for every segment
form.faresHint: Whole amounts. A segment must not cost less than a shorter segment within it.
form.legs: Suggestion from one price per leg
form.missing: Enter a whole amount for every segment ({count} missing).

policies.title: Cancellation policies
policies.empty: No cancellation policy yet. A route needs one.
policies.noPassengerCancel: Passengers may not cancel paid bookings
policies.standardText: Free up to 24 hours before departure, 25 % from 2 hours, 50 % after that.

errors.CANCELLATION_POLICY_NOT_FOUND: This cancellation policy does not exist in your company.
